headline: Besieged Sudanese city faces relentless drone strikes and risk of mass atrocities, U.N. warns
context: Hundreds of thousands of civilians in el-Obeid are being battered by relentless drone strikes and face critical water shortages and a worsening cholera outbreak, while women and girls are reporting high rates of sexual violence.

sources.name: NPR
